name: Kaleidoscope
description: Quarter discs and small squares, chosen cell by cell and mirrored about both middle lines, so the sheet reads as one big kaleidoscope.

code.style: --rule: ( --a: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2)); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { transform: scale(@calc(round((2 * (@dx >= 0) - 1) * 100) / 100), @calc(round((2 * (@dy >= 0) - 1) * 100) / 100)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: 100% 0 0 0; background: @var(--a); transform: rotate(@calc(round((90 * floor(((sin(abs(@dx) * 12.9898 + abs(@dy) * 78.233 + 0.7) * 43758.5453) - floor(sin(abs(@dx) * 12.9898 + abs(@dy) * 78.233 + 0.7) * 43758.5453)) * 4)) * 100) / 100)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 25%; border-radius: @calc(round((50 * (((sin(abs(@dx) * 39.346 + abs(@dy) * 11.135 + 0.7) * 24634.6345) - floor(sin(abs(@dx) * 39.346 + abs(@dy) * 11.135 + 0.7) * 24634.6345)) > 0.5)) * 100) / 100)%; background: @p(var(--color3), var(--color4)); transform: rotate(@calc(round((45 * floor(((sin(abs(@dx) * 39.346 + abs(@dy) * 11.135 + 0.7) * 24634.6345) - floor(sin(abs(@dx) * 39.346 + abs(@dy) * 11.135 + 0.7) * 24634.6345)) * 4)) * 100) / 100)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
